notes.title: BIG UPDATE! Pre-Alpha 2.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981030/33e93ffade0ee275cc27ac4bb85122c72a047db6.gif[/img]
[h1]Reworked core game mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Weapon crafting removed[/b] and replaced with a giant frog's shop
[*]Search for [b]trinkets [/b]hidden in the world and trade them in for coins!
[*]Weapon [b]upgrades [/b]/ variants
[*]Find [b]coins [/b]throughout the world or by killing enemies
[*]Weapon ammo / reloading
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981030/1ab24239a9a2721e715fae5e8f39ebf4807e9000.jpg[/img]
[h1]Big Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fun[b] interactive flowers [/b]and mushrooms to fidget with
[*]New enemy wave system
[*]Better difficulty scaling for different amounts of players
[*]Enemy spawner buildings
[*]More Islands
[*]Improved Visuals
[*]Major [b]Performance Improvements[/b] (2x faster) (very smoove)
[*]Improved boss level layout + Enemies spawn in waves and navigate the level
[*]Too many bug fixes to count
[/list]

[h2]Small Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Drop left-hand items.
[*]Re-balanced weapons.
[*]Dynamic fall distance
[*]Level generation spawn position rework
[*]Soul improvements (the glowing orb when you die)
[*]Improved trees
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981030/0d33aab66d065b919b8ed573c865d908627b517b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Combat Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Big Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a [b]ranged enemy[/b].
[*] Enemies now [b]wander[/b] instead of just sitting there.
[*] Enemies occasionally fall back during combat.
[*] The [b]blue pistol[/b] does big damage at a slow fire rate like the deagle.
[*] You lose your inventory when you die.
[/list]

[h3]Small Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies flash when hit.
[*] Adjusted health regen for the player.
[*] Improved health overlay.
[*] Adjusted damage values of each of the weapons again.
[*] Slight tweaks to movement.  You have a higher range of jump heights depending on how long you hold the spacebar.
[/list]

Peace guys I hope everyone has a good day for real

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981030/93c34581dea930662cc935b1da86f9505e8aa5ff.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ecto Initial Patch
notes.notes:
Ecto had a decent launch.  I was worried about the lack of content but it was reassuring seeing that people still had fun playing it.  This update addresses some of the most common issues with the game from day 1.

[list]
[*] Tweaked the weapon stats to attempt to balance their strengths and weaknesses better
[*] Fixed a bug where you get stuck at the bottom of the well
[*] The knife is limited to only damaging 3 enemies per hit
[*] Robots chase players more effectively at close ranges
[*] Fixed minor performance studdering on clients
[*] Held Frogs no longer get hit when attacking with the knife
[/list]

[b]Thanks to everyone who played and gave their feedback![/b]  I'm just a singular wrinkydink human being and the potential quality of what I can create is greater as I hear more people's inputs and ideas.

PEACE AND MUCH LOVE YUUUUUPPP <4
